patterns.name: stripes
patterns.describe: straight parallel lines across the shape, long

patterns.name: bricks
patterns.describe: rows joined by short rungs, shifted from row to row (short lines, many Ts)

patterns.name: rings
patterns.describe: copies of the outline nested inside each other, joined by rungs

patterns.name: ripples
patterns.describe: circles around a point, like ripples

patterns.name: weave
patterns.describe: two directions crossing each other (crossings never block)

patterns.name: rays
patterns.describe: lines fanning out from a point

patterns.name: tiles
patterns.describe: vertical rows joined by short rungs

patterns.name: lattice
patterns.describe: two diagonals crossing: a diamond lattice

patterns.name: corner ripples
patterns.describe: arcs around a corner of the picture
